en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a wild river or rapids running through a rocky gorge with forested cliffs on both sides. A metal truss bridge spans the water in the middle distance, anchored on rocks in the stream. Stylized clouds are drawn at the top left margin, giving the image a slightly illustrated frame. In the lower left corner, small caption text identifies the location.
